 Using cheat codes can make exploring the massive GTA 6 world more entertaining, especially if you want to experiment with weapons, vehicles, and other locked features. However, players who want to unlock every trophy and achievement may wonder whether using cheats will affect their progress. Let’s answer whether using cheat codes in GTA 6 affects your trophy and achievement collection.
 Do Cheats Disable Trophies and Achievements in GTA 6?
 Using GTA 6 cheat codes will temporarily disable achievements on Xbox and trophies on PlayStation for the current game session, based on what we’ve seen in GTA 5 or RDR2.
 Don’t worry, activating cheat codes temporarily disables trophies and achievements in GTA 6. You can continue playing and save your progress, but you cannot unlock achievements or trophies while cheats are active.
 Image Credit: Rockstar Games Restarting the game or reloading a save without active cheats restores trophy and achievement eligibility in GTA 5. Similarly, if you are trying to unlock a new GTA 6 weapon through the cheat, make sure you save the game beforehand.
 Yes, we recommend keeping a separate save file before experimenting with cheats. This will help you avoid potentially affecting a GTA 6 walkthrough in which you are trying to unlock every trophy and achievement.
 So, will you use the GTA 6 cheats and let the game disable your trophies and achievements? Or will you enjoy exploring locations in GTA 6 ‘s Leonida with no regrets? Let us know in the comments.
 Do cheats disable trophies and achievements in GTA 6 story? Yes, using cheats will stop trophies and achievements for your GTA 6 session.
 Can you get achievements after using cheats in GTA 6? You can save the game and restore the session to remove the cheat usage and continue unlocking trophies.
